editorial: Today's technology agenda highlights the interaction of artificial intelligence models with the physical world and the impact of developer tools on data privacy. The auto-ontology studies published by NVIDIA and the integration of robotic systems with foundation models signal a search for a new standard in system architectures.

items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, auto-ontology is a Python framework that enables the creation of semantic and graph-based reasoning layers on data. This tool helps achieve more explainable results through deterministic query generation for large language models (LLMs) and AI agent workflows.

snapshot.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: Mattpocock/skills contains AI agent skills used in real engineering processes, taken directly from the author's .agents directory. The project focuses on achieving concrete results in daily software development workflows rather than theoretical applications.

snapshot.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory. My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

items.title: garrytan/gstack
items.summary: Shared by Garry Tan, gstack offers 23 different customized toolsets for the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code. This structure aims to automate the workflows of various roles such as manager, designer, engineering manager, and quality assurance specialist.

snapshot.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

items.title: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
items.summary: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor is a system that uses the browser automation tool Playwright and artificial intelligence to perform multi-task tracking and analysis on the second-hand product platform Xianyu. Developed to help users easily find the products they are looking for, this tool offers a comprehensive web interface where all processes can be managed.

snapshot.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。. 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。

items.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
items.summary: Scrapling is a web scraping framework capable of managing the entire process from simple data requests to comprehensive crawling operations. Developed in Python, this tool allows users to execute data collection workflows through a single infrastructure.

snapshot.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.summary: Developed by Vercel Labs, agent-desktop is a command-line interface (CLI) that allows AI agents to see and manage desktop applications on macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems. Written in Rust, this tool uses the operating system's accessibility tree to enable agents to perform operations on the computer.

snapshot.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents. Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.summary: Worktrunk is a command-line interface (CLI) written in Rust that simplifies Git worktree management. The software is a tool developed to enable AI agents to execute parallel workflows more efficiently.

snapshot.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel.

items.title: lz4/lz4
items.summary: Developed in C, lz4 is a lossless data compression algorithm that offers speeds of over 500 MB per second per core. Thanks to its structure that can reach RAM speed limits on multi-core systems, it provides very fast decoding performance.

snapshot.description: Extremely Fast Compression algorithm. LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core, scalable with multi-core CPUs. It features an extremely fast decoder, with speed in multiple GB/s per core, typically reaching RAM speed limits on multi-core systems.

items.title: google/skills
items.summary: Developed by Google, skills offers skill packages for AI agents for technologies such as Google products and Google Cloud. This repository was created to support agent-based workflows that work integrated with these technologies.

snapshot.description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies. This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, including Google Cloud.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.summary: Developed by Vercel Labs, agent-browser is a command-line interface (CLI) that provides browser automation for AI agents. Written in Rust, this tool reads pages as an accessibility tree and allows interaction with web elements via the command line.

snapshot.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

items.title: scenario-labs/skills
items.summary: scenario-labs/skills offers a library that enables AI agents to produce visual, auditory, and three-dimensional content. This tool performs cost analysis by selecting the appropriate model and uses the Scenario MCP protocol to maintain consistency in content.

snapshot.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.

items.title: ConardLi/garden-skills
items.summary: ConardLi/garden-skills is an open-source collection of ready-to-use skill packages prepared for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Including various functions such as web design, information retrieval, and image generation, this library aims to support agent-based workflows for developers.

snapshot.description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more. A curated collection of production-ready Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding agents.

items.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
items.summary: Developed by Microsoft, VibeVoice is a family of open-source voice-based AI models that combine text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) capabilities. These models aim to provide a comprehensive solution for both speech synthesis and analysis in audio processing workflows.

snapshot.description: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI. VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models.

items.title: floci-io/floci
items.summary: Floci is an open-source local AWS emulator designed for development, testing, and continuous integration (CI) processes. Written in Java, this tool offers the ability to work in a local environment as an alternative to cloud infrastructure services.

snapshot.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative. Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.

items.title: JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio
items.summary: DiscImageStudio is a multi-platform disk image creation and burning tool developed to etch visible images onto the surface of CDs, DVDs, and single-layer Blu-ray discs. Written in C#, this application allows for visual processing on disk surfaces using standard optical drives.

snapshot.description: Disc Image Studio 是一个多平台的光盘盘面图像生成与刻录工具，帮助您使用任何刻录光驱在任何 DVD / CD / 单层蓝光 光盘上刻蚀出肉眼可见的图像。

items.title: sshole
items.summary: sshole is a platform discussing the password authentication changes introduced with OpenSSH version 10.6p2 and the impact of these updates on system security. Users are evaluating what these changes mean for remote access protocols and secure connection processes.

snapshot.description: Related:https://hachyderm.io/@damienmiller/117563026759098135 / https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50377221https://www.openssh.org/releasenotes.html#10.6p2https://alpinelinux.org/posts/2026-11-05-openssh-password-au...

items.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
items.summary: Claude Code, a command-line tool developed by Anthropic, transmits the user's email address to third-party websites via the User-Agent header during web searches. This situation has raised security and privacy concerns due to data sharing occurring without user consent.

snapshot.description: Bug Description I receive dozens of scam emails per day because claude code divulged my email to arbitrary 3rd parties in the User-Agent request header while conducting web searches without my permission. This should not be a setting wit...

items.title: Search for everyone
items.summary: Kagi has launched the 'Search for everyone' feature to bring its search engine service to a wider audience. This update aims to make the platform's search experience accessible to all users.

items.title: Goodbye from Salon
items.summary: Salon has announced that it is ending its publication life and bidding farewell to its readers. The platform, which has been a long-standing presence in online journalism, conveyed its thanks to its readers in a farewell message.

snapshot.description: It has been an extraordinary privilege.

items.title: Motorola Signature 27 with GrapheneOS support
items.summary: Motorola Signature 27 has been announced with support for GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused mobile operating system. This new device aims to offer users a customizable software experience that prioritizes security.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and textual data. Developed by applying large-scale reinforcement learning on top of the Kimi K3 model, it is presented as the first member of the K3.1 series.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date. Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series.

items.title: speridlabs/idol
items.summary: Developed by Speridlabs, idol is an image-to-3D conversion model capable of creating a 3D Gaussian splat from a single image. Outputting in the standard 3DGS .ply format, this model can run in under 2 seconds on consumer-grade graphics processors.

snapshot.description: image-to-3d model. Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, written as a standard 3DGS .ply. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.

items.title: ccore/Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, ccore/Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder is an experiment exploring the applicability of small language models in general-purpose coding and high-quality 3D scene generation processes. The model aims to test the potential for performing complex tasks with a limited number of parameters.

snapshot.description: An experiment exploring the feasibility of small language models for general-purpose coding and high-quality 3D scene generation.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: LTX-2.5, developed by Lightricks, is an image-to-video AI model that transforms images into moving videos. Accessible via the Hugging Face platform, this tool focuses on image-based video generation processes.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
items.summary: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B, developed by NVIDIA, is an open-weight automatic speech recognition model capable of transcribing in 40 languages. Supporting recordings up to one hour long, the model offers offline audio and speech processing capabilities through its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture.

snapshot.description: automatic-speech-recognition model. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.

items.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
items.summary: WeLM-Image is an integrated visual foundation model that combines text-to-image generation, instruction-based editing, and multi-reference synthesis processes. Designed to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU), the model was developed for use in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications.

snapshot.description: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. Designed for single-GPU deployment in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications, the model processes text, reference images, and target latents as one interleaved sequence. items.title: Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
items.summary: Open-HumanScale offers an open-source method that uses egocentric human videos for training embodied foundation models. Consisting of 50,000 hours of video data labeled with hand movements and natural language descriptions, this work aims to scale robotic learning processes.

snapshot.description: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanScale, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanScale-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. items.title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
items.summary: NPCBench is a clinical training benchmark developed to measure multimodal reasoning capabilities in the treatment of nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Unlike existing medical evaluation methods, this tool aims to test the ability of AI models to integrate specialized knowledge with the patient care process.

snapshot.description: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. items.title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
items.summary: EDGAR is a conditional diffusion framework developed to resolve geometric distortions and texture errors in head avatars created via the Gaussian splatting method. This method aims to achieve more realistic results by correcting issues such as blurriness and temporal instability encountered in single-image or video-based models.

snapshot.description: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. items.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face discusses a benchmark compression method that reduces model evaluation costs. The study demonstrates that random sampling can be sufficient to produce estimates close to full benchmark results using small subsets.

snapshot.description: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results.
